issues.description: The symbol 'CAV' in 'Kupffer-like macrophages expressing endothelial transcripts ENG, KDR, and CAV' is ambiguous (could be CAV1, CAV2, or CAV3) and was therefore not added as a new finding.
'CD3' is used as a negative B-cell gating marker ('DAPI–CD3–CD20+') but is an ambiguous symbol (CD3D/CD3E/CD3G) in the provided text; not added as a new finding.

The provided markdown contains figure legends but not the gene-level content of marker dot plots in fig. S4 and fig. S29A; markers unique to those panels could not be independently verified from the text.

Final annotated cell-label counts are not enumerated in the provided markdown, so a quantitative comparison with the 75 global Leiden clusters to assess possible missing annotation labels could not be performed.
